formats.name: QuickTime
formats.notes: Sent to browsers as MPEG-4, which is what they play it as.

formats.name: Camcorder MPEG
formats.notes: MOD and TOD files from camcorders. A .mod in a music library is a tracker song instead.

formats.name: Video CD track
formats.notes: Only when its content really is an MPEG stream.

formats.name: Raw VVC
formats.notes: Needs an FFmpeg that decodes VVC.

formats.name: TiVo recording
formats.notes: Only recordings that aren't encrypted. Encrypted ones are refused.

formats.name: MPEG-4 audio
formats.notes: Plays in a browser with AAC inside. ALAC is converted.

formats.name: MIDI
formats.needs: Nothing extra: the server has its own synthesiser
formats.notes: Played by the server's built-in synthesiser, which is simple but needs no sound font.

formats.name: Advanced SubStation
formats.notes: Shown as plain text by default, or burned in to keep its styling.

formats.name: SubStation Alpha
formats.notes: Shown as plain text by default, or burned in to keep its styling.

formats.name: MicroDVD, SubViewer or VobSub
formats.notes: A .sub beside an .idx is VobSub, a picture format, and is burned in. Other .sub files are text.

formats.name: VobSub index
formats.notes: Pictures from a DVD, read with the .sub beside it, and burned into the picture.

formats.name: Blu-ray PGS
formats.notes: Pictures from a Blu-ray, burned into the picture.

formats.name: Timed lyrics
formats.notes: Beside a song, these are its lyrics. Beside a video, a subtitle track.

formats.name: JPEG
formats.notes: A motion photo's clip, stored after the picture, plays with it.

formats.name: SVG
formats.notes: Scripts, outside links and active content are removed before it is sent. FFmpeg with librsvg makes smaller copies when it has it.

formats.name: HEIC and HEIF
formats.needs: An FFmpeg of version 7 or later

formats.name: JPEG XL
formats.notes: A file with this name and no JPEG XL signature isn't listed: FFmpeg would work at one for minutes and find nothing.

formats.name: Kindle (MOBI)
formats.notes: Copy-protected Kindle books are refused.

formats.name: Kindle (AZW)
formats.notes: Copy-protected Kindle books are refused.

formats.name: Kindle (KF8)
formats.notes: Copy-protected Kindle books are refused.

formats.name: Word 97-2003 document
formats.notes: Its text is shown, without pictures or layout.

formats.name: Web page
formats.notes: Scripts and outside links are removed before it is shown.

formats.name: DjVu
formats.needs: The DjVuLibre tools on the server (ddjvu), to open it
formats.notes: Pages are drawn by DjVuLibre when it is installed. Without it the book is still listed, and can be downloaded.

formats.name: Disc image
formats.notes: DVD, Blu-ray or audio CD. Encrypted discs are refused.

formats.name: Disc image
formats.notes: DVD, Blu-ray or audio CD.

formats.name: Raw disc image
formats.notes: Read through the .cue beside it. An audio CD, or a data image of a DVD or Blu-ray.

formats.name: CUE sheet
formats.notes: Splits one long sound file, or a raw image, into tracks. The tracks of the sheet appear as one album.

formats.name: Alcohol image
formats.notes: Images that keep whole sectors of a DVD. The .mds beside it isn't needed.

formats.name: DVD folder (VIDEO_TS)
formats.notes: A folder that holds VIDEO_TS is one disc.

formats.name: Blu-ray folder (BDMV)
formats.notes: A folder that holds BDMV is one disc.

formats.name: M3U playlist
formats.notes: Becomes a playlist of the songs it names that are in the library. Web addresses in it are ignored.

formats.name: PLS playlist
formats.notes: As M3U.

formats.name: XSPF playlist
formats.notes: As M3U.

formats.name: Windows Media playlist
formats.notes: As M3U.

formats.name: NFO details
formats.notes: Titles and details saved beside a film, show or album.

formats.name: Thumbnail beside a file
formats.notes: Artwork beside a file. So is any picture named poster, fanart, folder, cover or after the file.

formats.name: Details in JSON
formats.notes: name.metadata.json, and the .info.json video archivers write.

codecs.name: HEVC / H.265
codecs.notes: Plays directly where the browser and machine decode it, otherwise converted.

codecs.name: VVC / H.266
codecs.notes: Needs an FFmpeg that decodes it.
